import asyncio
import os
import re
import time
from urllib.parse import quote
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

class FastGrokipediaScraper:
    def __init__(self, base_url=""):
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.all_article_titles = set()
        self.scraped_count = 0
        self.total_to_scrape = 0
        self.start_time = None
        self._counter_lock = asyncio.Lock()

    def clean_text(self, html):
        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
        for element in soup([
            "script",
            "style",
            "nav",
            "footer",
            "header",
            "noscript",
            "meta",
            "link",
            "button",
            "svg",
            "path",
            "iframe",
        ]):
            element.decompose()
        text = soup.get_text(separator="\n")
        lines = []
        ignore = {
            "Toggle theme",
            "Login",
            "Search",
            "Ctrl+K",
            "Fact-checked by Grok",
        }
        for line in text.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            if line and line not in ignore:
                lines.append(line)
        clean_text = "\n".join(lines)
        clean_text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", clean_text)
        return clean_text.strip()

    def sanitize_filename(self, title):
        filename = re.sub(r"[^\w\-_]+", "_", title)
        filename = re.sub(r"_+", "_", filename).strip("_")
        if not filename:
            filename = "article"
        if len(filename) > 200:
            filename = filename[:200]
        return f"{filename}.txt"

    async def collect_article_titles_from_search(self, page, search_term, max_pages=50):
        titles = set()
        await page.goto(f"{self.base_url}/search?q={quote(search_term)}", timeout=30000, wait_until="domcontentloaded")
        await asyncio.sleep(1.5)
        for _ in range(max_pages):
            try:
                text_content = await page.evaluate("() => document.body.innerText")
            except Exception:
                break
            lines = text_content.split("\n")
            for line in lines:
                s = line.strip()
                if (
                    s
                    and 2 < len(s) < 200
                    and s not in {"Login", "Toggle theme", "Search", "Previous", "Next"}
                    and not s.startswith("Search for")
                    and not s.isdigit()
                    and "›" not in s
                    and "..." not in s
                ):
                    titles.add(s)
            next_button = await page.query_selector("a:has-text('Next'), button:has-text('Next')")
            if next_button:
                try:
                    await next_button.click()
                    await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
                except Exception:
                    break
            else:
                break
        return titles

    async def collect_all_article_titles(self):
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            chromium_executable = os.environ.get("CHROMIUM_PATH")
            if chromium_executable and os.path.exists(chromium_executable):
                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True, executable_path=chromium_executable)
            else:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            page = await browser.new_page()
            search_terms = [
                "a", "the", "of", "and", "in", "to", "is", "for", "on", "at",
                "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "i", "j", "k", "l", "m",
                "n", "o", "p", "q", "r", "s", "t", "u", "v", "w", "x", "y", "z",
                "war", "history", "science", "art", "music", "politics", "religion",
                "country", "city", "person", "theory", "law", "book", "film",
            ]
            for search_term in search_terms:
                try:
                    titles = await self.collect_article_titles_from_search(page, search_term, max_pages=300)
                    self.all_article_titles.update(titles)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            await page.close()
            await browser.close()
        self.total_to_scrape = len(self.all_article_titles)

    async def scrape_single_article(self, context, title):
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            slug = quote(title.replace(" ", "_"))
            url = f"{self.base_url}/page/{slug}"
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
            html = await page.content()
            text = self.clean_text(html)
            if text and len(text) > 100:
                filename = self.sanitize_filename(title)
                filepath = os.path.join("scraped_content", filename)
                with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    f.write(f"URL: {url}\n")
                    f.write("=" * 80 + "\n\n")
                    f.write(text)
                async with self._counter_lock:
                    self.scraped_count += 1
                    if self.scraped_count % 50 == 0:
                        elapsed = time.time() - self.start_time if self.start_time else 0
                        rate = self.scraped_count / (elapsed / 60) if elapsed > 0 else 0
                        print(f"[PROGRESS] {self.scraped_count}/{self.total_to_scrape} ({rate:.1f}/min)", flush=True)
                return True
            return False
        except Exception:
            return False
        finally:
            await page.close()

    async def parallel_scraper_worker(self, worker_id, context, queue):
        while True:
            title = await queue.get()
            if title is None:
                queue.task_done()
                break
            try:
                await self.scrape_single_article(context, title)
                await asyncio.sleep(0)
            finally:
                queue.task_done()

    async def scrape_all_parallel(self, num_workers=10):
        os.makedirs("scraped_content", exist_ok=True)
        titles_list = list(self.all_article_titles)
        self.start_time = time.time()
        async with async_playwright() as p:
            chromium_executable = os.environ.get("CHROMIUM_PATH")
            if chromium_executable and os.path.exists(chromium_executable):
                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True, executable_path=chromium_executable)
            else:
                browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
            contexts = []
            for _ in range(max(1, num_workers)):
                context = await browser.new_context()
                contexts.append(context)
            queue = asyncio.Queue()
            for t in titles_list:
                await queue.put(t)
            workers = []
            for i in range(len(contexts)):
                task = asyncio.create_task(self.parallel_scraper_worker(i + 1, contexts[i], queue))
                workers.append(task)
            await queue.join()
            for _ in range(len(contexts)):
                await queue.put(None)
            await asyncio.gather(*workers, return_exceptions=True)
            for context in contexts:
                await context.close()
            await browser.close()
        elapsed = time.time() - self.start_time if self.start_time else 0
        rate = self.scraped_count / (elapsed / 60) if elapsed > 0 else 0
        print("=" * 80, flush=True)
        print("SCRAPING COMPLETE!", flush=True)
        print(f"Articles scraped: {self.scraped_count}", flush=True)
        print(f"Time elapsed: {elapsed/60:.1f} minutes", flush=True)
        print(f"Average rate: {rate:.1f} articles/minute", flush=True)
        print("All content saved in 'scraped_content' directory", flush=True)
        print("=" * 80, flush=True)

async def main():
    scraper = FastGrokipediaScraper()
    await scraper.collect_all_article_titles()
    if scraper.total_to_scrape > 0:
        await scraper.scrape_all_parallel(num_workers=10)
    else:
        print("No articles found to scrape!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
